Description: A Camp King account is a "troop" — a grouping of associated people represented by profiles set up under it. Holds billing, security, master controls.
Notes: Foundational identity model. Netflix-shape household.

Description: Exactly one adult leader per troop in v1. Singleton role; not a set.
Notes: Co-leadership deferred (see FEAT-011).

Description: Up to 6 sub-profiles per troop in addition to the leader (7 profiles maximum). Leader chooses who gets a sub-profile; no platform-level age classification.
Notes: v1 troop size cap. Larger tier deferred (see FEAT-012).

Description: Avatar grid on app launch; tap to enter profile. Device remembers last-active profile; "Switch profile" always one tap.
Notes: Netflix-style UX.

Description: Leader's profile always requires a PIN set at troop creation; resettable via OAuth/OTP identity.
Notes: Always-on for leader; sub-profile PINs are optional.

Description: Leader can mark any sub-profile "protected" requiring a PIN to enter. Default not protected.
Notes: Flexible per-sub-profile lockdown.

Description: 15-row toggle matrix the leader sets per sub-profile (post / forward / contacts / voice / geo / ads / merchant / LiDAR / Camp Atlas / DM / cast / trips, plus always-on block-report).
Notes: Block / report is never gateable. Defaults skew restrictive.

Description: Troop leader attests at troop creation that every sub-profile user is 13 or older. Standard general-purpose social-platform posture.
Notes: No platform-level kids classification; avoids COPPA / GDPR-K scope.

Feature: Troop leader feature gate management UI
Description: Settings panel where the leader flips per-sub-profile feature toggles individually or in bulk.
Notes: UX implied by gate matrix. Owns the leader→sub-profile control surface.

Description: Real under-13 profiles with verified parental consent, data minimisation, App Store / Play Store kids-category rules. Material legal lift.
Notes: Mentioned in audience-branding section as deferred. Flag for legal review.

Description: Two or more adult identities sharing leader privileges; one-way ownership transfer from current leader to another adult identity.
Notes: Deferred item 15. Auth / billing / audit-trail implications.

Description: Higher-tier troop sized for scout troops, extended families, classrooms. Tiered pricing, larger import quotas, possible federated troops.
Notes: Deferred item 16.

Description: Each profile has its own contact list, mutual-discovery state, feed. Profiles in the same troop do NOT share a social graph by default.
Notes: Foundational privacy posture.

Description: Two profiles see each other in-app only if BOTH uploaded the other's contact info AND both are registered. Profile-pair-keyed.
Notes: Drives the dark-green direct-contact border.

Description: Per-friend toggle "let X see who I'm connected to." Grantee sees registered profiles only, never raw contacts. No further hops. Not transferable across siblings.
Notes: Drives the light-green friend-of-friend border.

Description: Profile uploads its own address book / CSV; rows are private to the uploader.
Notes: Step 2 of cross-platform verification. Default off for new sub-profiles.

Description: Leader flicks "Share with troop" on individual contacts; sub-profiles see them in a distinct "Shared by Leader" segment. Live-revocable; bulk-shareable.
Notes: First explicit exception to "raw contacts uploader-only" invariant.

Feature: Privacy invariant: contacts uploader-only + 2 leader exceptions
Description: Raw uploaded contacts visible only to uploader. Two opt-in per-contact leader exceptions: share-with-troop, share-with-trip.
Notes: GDPR / CCPA-defensible posture.

Description: Separate top-level section of the app for multi-troop camping events.
Notes: New IA surface alongside the feed.

Description: Troop leader creates a trip; required field is a name. Status starts as draft.
Notes: Step 1 of trip lifecycle.

Description: Name (required) + description, location_text, start_date, end_date, cover_image_url, status. All others optional.
Notes: Geo polygons, itineraries, RSVPs etc. deferred (FEAT-033).

Description: Trip transitions: draft → active (on first accept) → ended (creator/co-leader marks). Ended is a read-only archive.
Notes: Historical trip-shared contacts remain visible after end.

Feature: Invite other troop leaders to a trip
Description: Trip creator or co-leader invites other troop leaders by phone / username. Invited troop sits at status=invited until accepted.
Notes: Multi-troop participation entry point.

Description: Invited troop's leader accepts; their entire troop joins the trip. All sub-profiles become trip members by default (subject to feature gate).
Notes: Step 3 of lifecycle.

Description: The single troop leader who created the trip. Full authority over trip settings / invites / lifecycle / co-leader promotion. Non-transferable in v1.
Notes: Transfer mechanics deferred (FEAT-035).

Description: Trip creator can promote any joined troop's leader to trip co-leader. Multiple co-leaders permitted. Co-leaders can invite, edit, share, end. Cannot demote creator.
Notes: Trip-scoped only; does NOT grant any access to that troop's master list.

Description: Each trip has its own shared contact list, separate from troop-shared and from individual contact lists. Visible to all trip members across joined troops.
Notes: "Trip contacts: [Trip name]" segment in member's contact list.

Description: Any troop leader on the trip flicks "Share with this trip" on contacts in their own master list. Bulk share; live-revocable.
Notes: Second explicit exception to "raw contacts uploader-only" invariant.

Description: Troop's leader can set per-trip "Trip visibility" to off for specific sub-profiles. Deselected sub-profile not enumerated to other trip members.
Notes: Per-trip override on top of the broader "Trip participation" feature gate.

Description: Per-sub-profile gate (default On) controlling whether the sub-profile can join trips at all. Per-trip override sits on top.
Notes: Row in the feature-gate matrix.

Description: Sub-profile's "Forward outside the troop" gate is NOT loosened by trip membership. Other trip members and trip-shared contacts both count as outside.
Notes: Keeps leader control uniform across surfaces.

Description: Joining a trip does NOT merge troops, share billing, or expose either troop's master contact list / sub-profile roster / feature gates to the other troop.
Notes: Hard boundary; load-bearing.

Description: Trip-filtered feed views, geo-polygons, itineraries, RSVPs, packing lists, post-trip albums, public / discoverable trips, trip-specific flair frames.
Notes: Deferred item 17. Each is its own design pass.

Description: Transfer trip creator role to a co-leader; or introduce a "co-creator" tier with elevated privileges short of full creator status.
Notes: Deferred item 18.

Description: Atomic content unit: image_url + caption + sensors + counts + tags + border-derived. Author is a profile_id, not a global user_id.
Notes: Schema lives in spec. Mock TS types built in M1.

Description: image_origin: camera | gallery | lidar_ai. lidar_ai is iOS Pro only.
Notes: Drives the LiDAR badge on cards.

Description: caption_mode = below renders text under image; = overlay places text on image with x/y/font/color/size from overlay_layout.
Notes: M1 web renders both modes from mock data.

Description: Optional 15s ambient/voice clip via voice_clip_url. iOS + Android only; web is read-only display.
Notes: Default off for new sub-profiles.

Description: forwarded_from_profile_id captures original author when card is forwarded. Recipient sees forwarded border + sender's username pinned.
Notes: Field renamed from forwarded_from_user_id when troop refactor landed.

Description: Denormalized counts: bookmark, firewood, match, lol, forward.
Notes: Updated server-side; read-only on client.

Description: 7 border kinds derived from social graph + image_origin + author flags. NOT stored.
Notes: M1 web hard-codes border kinds on mock cards; will derive at render once backend lands.

Description: New card type: 30–60s walk-around → cloud GPU 3DGS scene → recipients orbit / pan in-feed. Per-post, author-owned.
Notes: Deferred item 13. Distinct from Camp Atlas (FEAT-090).

Description: Tap + → blank template → image source → flair → caption → preview → tag → post.
Notes: Not yet built; M1 + button stubs to a toast.

Description: ~12 PNG/SVG decorative overlays (campfire, pine, lantern, hammock, canoe, marshmallow, compass-rose). Composited client-side at upload.
Notes: Asset set lives at assets/flair/.

Description: 1–2 sentence text entry below image. Supports "Convert to overlay" (FEAT-046).
Notes: Step 5 of creation flow.

Description: "Convert to overlay" moves caption onto the image with movable / resizable / font / color controls.
Notes: Web uses HTML5 Canvas; mobile uses native Reanimated.

Description: Right-arrow → preview the composited card; left-arrow returns to editor.
Notes: Step 6 of creation flow.

Description: v1: single locked chip ""camping"" auto-applied to every card. Schema is array-based.
Notes: Multi-tag system deferred (FEAT-049).

Description: Beyond "camping": informative, help, ask, announcement, etc.
Notes: Deferred item 8.

Description: Image + flair frame composited on device into one final PNG/JPEG. No per-view rendering.
Notes: Web uses Canvas / OffscreenCanvas; mobile native.

Description: iOS Pro only. RGB + depth → composed source → nano banana (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image) → image_origin=lidar_ai. 5 generations / user / day.
Notes: Hardware-gated. Only v1 use of nano banana.

Description: Generate cards from a free-text prompt (general nano banana flow).
Notes: Deferred item 9. v1 has the narrow LiDAR variant only.

Description: Each card occupies most of the screen, top-aligned. Swipe / arrow-key advances.
Notes: M1 web ships this with native CSS scroll-snap.

Description: Button collapses the feed to ~12 cards on screen; tap a card returns to full-screen on it.
Notes: M1 web ships this; press 'g' or tap Grid pill.

Description: 60 seconds of no interaction → enter slideshow mode. Any user input exits.
Notes: M1 web ships this. Wake-lock wired on mobile in v1 work to come.

Description: Advance one card every 25 seconds during slideshow.
Notes: M1 web ships this.

Description: Persistent bottom strip with the + button to enter card creation flow.
Notes: M1 web ships UI; tap stubs to a toast — real flow is FEAT-043.

Description: Long-press (touch) or right-click (desktop) opens a 4-action menu: firewood / match / bookmark / block-report. ONLY actions without a gesture equivalent.
Notes: M1 web ships UI + toast stubs; backend wiring is later v1 work.

Description: Swipe down on a card fires LOL reaction.
Notes: M1 web ships gesture detection + pulse + toast.

Description: Swipe up on a card opens forward picker. Recipient sees forwarded border + sender's username pinned.
Notes: M1 web ships gesture + toast; real picker modal is later v1 work.

Description: Modal contact list to choose forward recipient. Subject to "Forward outside the troop" feature gate.
Notes: Currently a toast stub in M1 web.

Description: Horizontal swipe on touch / arrow keys on desktop advances feed.
Notes: Native CSS scroll-snap on web.

Description: Person-to-person threaded messaging.
Notes: Deferred item 1.

Description: default(black/solid), ad(gray/dashed), forwarded(white/dotted), system(red/wavy), direct_contact(dark-green/double), friend_of_friend(light-green/thin), merchant(gold/chevron). Pattern is the accessibility primary; color enriches.
Notes: M1 web renders all 7 via SVG. Snapshot tests required.

Description: Image + caption text classifiers flag adult / violence / hate / PII. Flagged posts go to review queue and never appear in feed until cleared.
Notes: ~$1–3 per 1000 posts API budget at launch.

Description: In-app reports route to the same review queue. Long-press menu always exposes block / report (never gateable).
Notes: Block / report is the always-on row in the feature-gate matrix.

Description: Device GPS / fused location populates geo_point on cards.
Notes: Web: Geolocation API (opt-in); iOS: Core Location; Android: FusedLocation.

Description: Barometer (or GPS-derived fallback) populates elevation_m.
Notes: iOS: CMAltimeter; Android: TYPE_PRESSURE. Web: not populated, display only.

Description: Magnetometer + gyroscope fused snapshot at capture moment populates compass_heading_deg.
Notes: iOS: CMMotionManager; Android: TYPE_ROTATION_VECTOR. Calibration prompt when noisy.

Description: "Trail mode" UI: tap to start at trailhead, tap to stop; distance attached to next card via trail_length_m.
Notes: iOS: CMPedometer + HealthKit; Android: Health Connect / Google Fit fallback.

Description: Native ambient-temp sensor when present; else weather-API fallback for the geo_point. ambient_temp_source records which.
Notes: iOS: no native sensor — always weather (WeatherKit). Android: rare native sensor (some Samsung); else Open-Meteo.

Description: Optional 15-second microphone capture attached to a card via voice_clip_url.
Notes: Default off for new sub-profiles.

Description: Web client displays sensor fields when present on a card but does not populate them, except geo_point opportunistically.
Notes: M1 web renders the sensor row when present on mock data.

Description: Primary auth at the troop level. Supabase Auth (Twilio / MessageBird routed). Verified number is the leader's.
Notes: One auth identity per troop.

Description: Alternate auth at troop level. Web: Supabase redirect; iOS: expo-auth-session; Android: expo-auth-session.
Notes: Apple parity required on iOS if Google offered.

Description: Mandatory on iOS if Google offered. Available on web and Android for parity.
Notes: App Store Review Guideline 4.8 compliance.

Description: Managed Postgres + Auth + Storage + Realtime + Edge Functions.
Notes: Single backend across all three clients.

Description: RLS on contacts / contact_matches / one_hop_grants / cards / troop_shared_contacts / profile_feature_gates / trips / trip_troops / trip_co_leaders / trip_shared_contacts / trip_profile_visibility. All keys profile-id.
Notes: Encodes the privacy invariants. Critical pre-flight test.

Description: Supabase Storage cards/ for posted PNGs/JPEGs; cards-originals/ optionally retained for re-edits.
Notes: Card image upload destination.

Description: v1 casting is OS screen-mirror only. Web: Cast tab (Chrome/Edge); iOS: AirPlay; Android: Google Cast.
Notes: No app-side cast SDK in v1.

Description: App-side cast support replacing v1 mirror-the-screen.
Notes: Deferred item 10.

Description: Next.js App Router, React 19 server components for feed pagination, client components for swipe surface. Tailwind v4 styling.
Notes: M1 web stands up the full stack.

Description: Installable as a PWA on desktop and mobile browsers; offline shell with cached chrome + recent N feed cards.
Notes: Not yet built; later v1 milestone.

Description: File input with accept=image/* and capture=environment for direct rear-camera capture on mobile browsers.
Notes: Tied to FEAT-043 card creation.

Description: Final composite is a single PNG/JPEG uploaded to Supabase Storage.
Notes: Web variant of FEAT-046 + FEAT-050.

Description: Screen Wake Lock API keeps the screen on while casting.
Notes: Browser support varies; gracefully degrades.

Description: Chrome 110+ / Edge 110+ / Safari 16+ / Firefox 115+. Older browsers get a "please update" page.
Notes: Gate older browsers at runtime.

Description: Expo SDK ≥ 51 managed workflow. Reanimated 3 + react-native-gesture-handler.
Notes: Shares packages/ui and packages/api-client with Android.

Description: Real-time render of the LiDAR depth field at zero light; navigation tool, not a content tool. No card creation in v1.
Notes: Custom Expo native module wrapping SwiftUI/Metal/RealityKit. 5-min auto-timeout.

Description: Capable device captures a 3DGS scene of a place; auto-shared to capturer's troop / contact group; Camp King owns the capture in perpetuity for broader redistribution.
Notes: Deferred item 14. iOS Pro first; Android with ToF / ARCore in a later wave. Major legal pre-work.

Description: On-device 3DGS accumulation of LiDAR + RGB for a wider perceived FOV than v1's raw point-cloud.
Notes: Deferred item 12. Bleeding-edge research.

Description: Categories: new_card_from_friend, forwarded_to_you, moderation_decision, system_announcement. Via expo-notifications.
Notes: Expo Push Service.

Description: OS-initiated via Control Center → Screen Mirroring. App keeps screen awake during slideshow.
Notes: No app-side AirPlay code in v1.

Description: Beta on TestFlight; production on App Store.
Notes: Bundle ID app.campking.ios placeholder.

Description: Expo SDK ≥ 51 managed workflow. Reanimated 3 + react-native-gesture-handler. Min SDK 26 / target 34+.
Notes: Shares packages/ui and packages/api-client with iOS.

Description: Channels: new_card_from_friend, forwarded_to_you, moderation_decision, system_announcement. Via expo-notifications.
Notes: Channel registration required Android 8+.

Description: OS-initiated via system Cast UI / Quick Settings tile. expo-keep-awake during slideshow.
Notes: No app-side cast receiver in v1.

Description: Software-derived depth via ARCore on supported devices for an Android LiDAR-fantastical equivalent path.
Notes: Decision in 30-android.md: not in v1; v2 if device coverage justifies.

Description: Internal testing → Closed testing → Production.
Notes: Application ID app.campking.android placeholder.

Description: Single production env + a staging env fed by main and a staging branch.
Notes: Decide at deploy time.

Description: 10-step cross-platform check + 8 troop scenarios + 8 trip scenarios. Runs on each client before declaring v1 done.
Notes: Owns the v1 ship gate.

Description: Unit tests for matching algo / troop-share rule / trip-share rule / feature-gate matrix. Snapshot tests for 7 borders. Playwright + Detox/Maestro e2e.
Notes: Required before declaring v1 done.

Description: Person-to-person threaded messaging.
Notes: Deferred item 1.

Description: Shared schedules and event RSVPs.
Notes: Deferred item 2.

Description: Carpool / ride coordination feature.
Notes: Deferred item 3.

Description: Multi-vehicle convoy coordination.
Notes: Deferred item 4.

Description: Real-time campsite availability + dispersed-camping data product.
Notes: Deferred item 5. Composes with Camp Atlas (FEAT-090).

Description: Bring new merchants onto the platform with a paid-connections marketplace.
Notes: Deferred item 6. v1 already has the gold-chevron border for existing merchants.

Description: Buying tools, boosted reach, billing infrastructure beyond v1.
Notes: Deferred item 7.

Description: If React Native proves limiting at scale.
Notes: Deferred item 11. Contingency only.
